polls.description: Chinese AI companies and robotics firms are surging with major market debuts, competitive models, and international expansion amid US-China tech tensions.
polls.question: Is China's AI surge a threat to US tech dominance or healthy competition?

cluster_stories.title: Scenes From the 2026 Beijing World Humanoid Robot Games
cluster_stories.summary: The 2026 World Humanoid Robot Games have begun. 666 teams from around the world are competing with more than 2,000 humanoid robots. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: BEIJING ROBOT OLYMPICS: 2,000 BOTS COMPETE

cluster_stories.title: Humanoid Robots Put China Ahead in Tech Race
cluster_stories.summary: China’s humanoid robot makers now control 97% of global shipments, giving Beijing an early lead over US rivals. But can they become everyday tools? At the World Robot Conference in Beijing, robots sort boxes, handle laundry and bag clothes, as Allen Wan finds out. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA DOMINATES: 97% of Global Humanoid Robot Shipments

cluster_stories.title: At Olympics-like event, Chinese robots smash athletic records set by humans — including Usain Bolt’s 100-meter sprint time
cluster_stories.summary: At a 100-meter sprint, a humanoid robot achieved a result of 9.39 seconds, beating the human record of 9.58 seconds set by the Jamaican athlete in 2009.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINESE ROBOT BREAKS USAIN BOLT'S 100M RECORD

cluster_stories.title: Humanoid Robot Beats Usain Bolt’s 100m World Record in Beijing
cluster_stories.summary: A humanoid robot ran 100 meters in 9.39 seconds at the opening ceremony of the second World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, beating Usain Bolt’s world record of 9.58 seconds, Xinhua News Agency reported.
cluster_stories.headline: HUMANOID ROBOT BREAKS USAIN BOLT'S 100M RECORD

cluster_stories.title: Humanoid Robots Put China Ahead in Tech Race
cluster_stories.summary: China’s humanoid robot makers now control 97% of global shipments, giving Beijing an early lead over U.S. rivals. At the World Robot Conference, robots sort boxes, handle laundry, and bag clothes, but the real test is whether they can become everyday tools. Bloomberg’s Allen Wan has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA DOMINATES HUMANOID ROBOTS... 97% Global Market Share

cluster_stories.title: A humanoid robot just beat Usain Bolt’s 100m record, and roboticists are unimpressed for good reason
cluster_stories.summary: A robot built by Beijing’s X-Humanoid ran 100 metres in 9.39 seconds at the World Humanoid Robot Games, beating Usain Bolt’s 9.58-second record. Roboticists point out that speed on a known course is far easier for a machine than folding laundry. A machine has run the 100 metres faster than any person ever has. cluster_stories.headline: CHINESE HUMANOID ROBOT BEATS USAIN BOLT'S 100M RECORD

cluster_stories.title: Robot horse and rider steal the spotlight at Chinese conference
cluster_stories.summary: More than 300 companies are showcasing the latest advances in robotics at the five-day event in Beijing, China, organisers say.
cluster_stories.headline: ROBOT HORSE AND RIDER Steal Show at Beijing Robotics Conference

cluster_stories.title: In Photos: Humanoid robots sprint, play soccer and set records at Beijing games
cluster_stories.summary: More than 2,000 humanoid robots run, play table tennis and soccer, and are setting records at the ongoing World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing, highlighting China’s rapid advances in robotics amid a tech race with the United States.

polls.description: Anthropic's rapid revenue growth and massive credit facility signals imminent IPO for OpenAI's major competitor.

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic’s Annualized Revenue Tops $65 Billion Before IPO
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $65 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar with the matter, up more than sevenfold from its pace at the end of last year. Bloomberg's Mandeep Singh joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC REVENUE HITS $65B BEFORE IPO—Up 7X in Months

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Pre-IPO Credit Facility to Rise Over $10 Billion
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic's revolving credit facility is anticipated to rise above its approximately $10 billion target, according to sources. That's a substantial increase over a $2.5 billion five-year facility the AI company secured last year, though discussions are still ongoing. Bloomberg's Sridhar Natarajan joins Ed Ludlow with the details on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC PRE-IPO CREDIT FACILITY EXCEEDS $10BN TARGET

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Pre-IPO Credit Facility Set to Climb Past $10 Billion
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC’s revolving credit facility is set to rise above its roughly $10 billion target, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence firm prepares for a highly anticipated initial public offering.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC IPO INCOMING: Credit Facility Surges Past $10 Billion

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic’s Revenue Surges as IPO Speculation Builds
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic is telling prospective investors its second-quarter revenue jumped at least 14-fold versus the same period a year ago, according to documents seen by Bloomberg News. This comes as speculation builds around a potential IPO. Bloomberg’s Rachel Metz breaks down the latest financial figures and how they compare with OpenAI’s growth. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC REVENUE SURGES 14X... IPO INCOMING

polls.description: Anthropic is preparing a potentially record-breaking IPO that could reach $2 trillion valuation, surpassing SpaceX's record while expanding operations with key hires and fundraising.
polls.question: Is a $2 trillion valuation for Anthropic justified or overheated speculation?

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Preps for Blockbuster Public Listing | Bloomberg Tech 8/21/2026
cluster_stories.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow takes a look at Anthropic as the AI company expects to match or top the size of SpaceX's record-setting IPO. Plus, sources say Broadcom is in talks to raise more than $60 billion in debt to help Anthropic and others secure chips and computing power, and all eyes are on Nvidia as the chipmaker reports earnings next week. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC IPO COULD BEAT SPACEX RECORD

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Aims to Match or Top SpaceX IPO
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic is aiming for an IPO that could make history, expecting to match or even top SpaceX's record-setting debut, according to sources. The maker of Claude could file publicly by the end of this month. The company raised $65 billion in May at a $965 billion valuation. Bloomberg's Shirin Ghaffary, who leads coverage of Anthropic, and Bloomberg's Liana Baker, who leads the deals team, join Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC TARGETS RECORD IPO... FILES THIS MONTH

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic could raise $100bn, ten times Europe’s largest listing in decades
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic could raise around $100bn in a listing as early as October, exceeding SpaceX’s record, with backers modelling a valuation of at least $2tn. The Financial Times reports that senior executives have not set a valuation target even privately. Anthropic’s listing now has a figure attached to it. Reports put the raise at around $100bn, […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC EYES $100BN RAISE... $2TN Valuation Target

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Taps Google Chip Veteran as Part of Push Into Hardware
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic PBC has hired Amir Salek, a founder of the custom chip program at Alphabet Inc.’s Google, as the AI lab lays the groundwork for a push into making its own semiconductors.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC HIRES Google Chip Veteran... Custom Silicon Push

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic Could Aim to Raise $100B in Blockbuster IPO

cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC EYES $100B IPO... OPENAI RIVAL GOES PUBLIC

cluster_stories.title: Can Anthropic Beat SpaceX’s Record IPO Size?
cluster_stories.summary: Anthropic expects to match or beat the size of SpaceX’s record-setting initial public offering, according to people familiar with the matter, in the latest sign of overwhelming demand from investors looking to profit from the artificial intelligence boom. Anthony Stephens has the latest. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC EYES RECORD IPO: Could Beat SpaceX Size

cluster_stories.title: Anthropic market debut could break SpaceX IPO record
cluster_stories.summary: The company's bankers have told potential investors it could seek to raise "more than $100 billion" in its IPO, which could put the company's value at $2 trillion, The New York Times reported Friday, citing two unnamed sources with knowledge of the talks.
cluster_stories.headline: ANTHROPIC IPO COULD HIT $2 TRILLION VALUATION
